QUOTE: By default it expands to `private_##m`, so the member is declared as `private_m` in the public header. ... Inside those translation units `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(m)` becomes plain `m`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the default expansion to private_<member> and that with MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS defined the macro becomes the plain member name.
